summary: FY2025 三个报告分部及其主要产品与服务组；所有内容为按官方原文人工阅读的候选，不含估算金额。

businesses.name: Microsoft
businesses.description: 提供软件、云服务、设备和在线广告；按 FY2025 三个报告分部组织本图。

monetization.description: 通过软件及服务、设备和广告业务取得收入。

businesses.name: Productivity and Business Processes
businesses.description: 生产力、协作和企业业务应用；采用 FY2025 调整后的分部口径。

businesses.name: Intelligent Cloud
businesses.description: 服务器产品、Azure 与其他云服务，以及企业与合作伙伴服务。

businesses.name: More Personal Computing
businesses.description: Windows 与设备、游戏，以及搜索和新闻广告。

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Commercial
businesses.description: 组织使用的 Office、Windows、Copilot、安全和管理工具。

monetization.description: 商业云订阅与本地软件许可；收入受用户规模、每用户收入和向云订阅转移影响。

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Consumer
businesses.description: 个人生产力产品及 Outlook.com、OneDrive 等消费者服务。

monetization.description: Microsoft 365 消费者订阅、本地 Office；通信和存储服务还由订阅及广告驱动。

businesses.name: LinkedIn
businesses.description: 面向专业人士和企业的招聘、营销、会员与销售平台。

monetization.description: Talent/Sales/Premium 订阅与 Marketing Solutions 赞助内容。

businesses.name: Dynamics
businesses.description: ERP、CRM、供应链及低代码应用平台。

monetization.description: 云端及本地应用许可；收入取决于许可用户、应用使用量及每用户收入。

businesses.name: Azure and other cloud services
businesses.description: 云计算、网络、存储与 AI；包含 GitHub 和 Nuance Healthcare 的云服务。

monetization.description: Azure 主要由 IaaS/PaaS 按使用量收费服务驱动；未将这一方式泛化到所有其他云服务。

businesses.name: Server products
businesses.description: 服务器操作系统、数据库、开发及管理软件。

monetization.description: 批量许可、OEM 许可及零售软件；CAL 收入归入对应服务器产品。

businesses.name: Enterprise and partner services
businesses.description: 帮助客户开发、部署和管理解决方案，提供支持、专业服务与培训认证。

monetization.description: 企业服务合同与相关服务；本次原文未拆解各项服务的具体计费单位。

businesses.name: Windows and Devices
businesses.description: Windows OEM 许可，以及 Surface 和 PC 配件。

monetization.description: 向 OEM 销售预装 Windows 许可，并销售 Surface 与 PC 配件。

businesses.name: Gaming
businesses.description: Xbox 硬件、第一方与第三方游戏内容、订阅及云游戏。

monetization.description: 硬件、游戏内容销售、订阅及广告。

businesses.name: Search and news advertising
businesses.description: 利用 Bing/Copilot、Edge、Microsoft News 和合作伙伴触达用户。

monetization.description: 搜索、原生及展示广告，以及合作伙伴搜索服务变现。

e-server.exact_quote: Our server products are designed to make IT professionals, developers, and their systems more productive and efficient. Server software is integrated server infrastructure and middleware designed to support software applications built on the Windows Server operating system. This includes the server platform, database, business intelligence, storage, management and operations, virtualization, service-oriented architecture platform, security, and identity software. We also license standalone and software development lifecycle tools for software architects, developers, testers, and project managers. Server products revenue is mainly affected by purchases through volume licensing programs, licenses sold to OEMs, and retail packaged products. CALs provide access rights to certain server products, including SQL Server and Windows Server, and revenue is reported along with the associated server product.
